scope: Shared cooling/RGB freeze barrier as required foundation for FanAndLighting group coordinator. No group commit or runtime install/Apply wiring yet.

contract.admission: Each sole-output actor acknowledges FreezeGroup after older command HID ACK and settings enqueue. Coordinator must obtain both ACKs before commit; all ordinary mutations return DeviceBusy while held. Read-only state and shutdown remain available.
contract.refresh: Cooling tick and all RGB refresh suppressed while held; no policy/base/thermal/dynamic output crosses the barrier. Existing runtime remains intact.
contract.ownership: Private random token, same-owner acquisition idempotent, foreign owner rejected, already released queued ticket rejected. Unsealed owner Drop releases both actors. Seal before durable commit; sealed Drop stays held even when sender closes. Explicit resume after known rejection or reconciliation; no automatic timeout/unfreeze of unknown outcome.
contract.integration: Internal actor APIs only. No IPC/CLI/GUI group import/Apply is enabled by this primitive. Normal actors without a ticket continue previous behavior.

regression.coverage: Real cooling/lighting actors, private fake HID with withheld ACK, private settings channel, synthetic temperature and paused Tokio cadence. Assert prior settings before freeze ACK, no output/deltas while held, every mutation reply Busy, state queries, fresh sensor value after resume, unchanged base, foreign/duplicate/late tickets, unsealed/sealed Drop and shutdown.

checks.hardware: NOT RUN: explicitly deferred; private queues and caches only

remaining: Coordinator preflight against prospective cooling/RGB/dynamic bases and retained global thermal
Durable receipt commit after both barriers; install both runtimes without old settings deltas; Apply/failure/reapply/recovery semantics
Group transport IPC/CLI/GUI, lifecycle/cancellation/fault matrix and Windows interoperability
Physical acceptance deferred; extra LCD effects and Style Express last
